# order: EO:2068  (WPA 1944: 1914 Oct 28)
# WPA summary: Addie Spofford Hess made eligiblefor appointment as clerkin the War Risk Insurance Bureau, Treasury Dept., without regard to CivilService Rules. 1915 CSR 117.
# book: Thirty-second Annual Report of the United States Civil Service Commission, fiscal year ended June 30, 1915
# scanned image 124, printed page 117; page lines 23-36
# source: https://archive.org/download/annualreportuni01commgoog/annualreportuni01commgoog_djvu.xml  sha256 92d8549007f776879ba70597db655a8e2deb53a49329d0574b35f0591c6fb041
# found by: monthday_and_names; date 1914-10-28; words addie|spofford|hess|risk|insurance
# Government printed copy (OCR of a compilation or report), not the signed original. A lead for the
# original_text step: read it against the scan before use. Exact slice of the page OCR follows.
----- EXACT SLICE -----
service with the Census Bureau, and her transfer to the Children's Bureau is recom-
mended by the Secretsuy of Labor and the chief of the Children's Bureau.
The Civil Service Conmiission does not concur in the recommendation.
October 28 1014.
Mrs. Addie Spofford Hess may be appointed a clerk in the Bureau of War Risk Insur-
ance of the Treasury Department without compliance with civil service rules. Mrs.
Hess's valuable experience in the Government service in filling excepted positioDs
particularly qualifies her for the work of the Bureau of War Risk Insurance. This
order is issued on the recommendation of the Secretary of the Treasury.
October 20, 1014.
Edward A. Gisbume may be appointed to a classified position without reference to
his physical condition after recommendation by some appointing officer and such
noncompetitive examination as the Civil Service Commission may require.
Mr. Gisbume was a messenger boy in the classified service of the Navy Department
